entries.title: Michigan: Report from Hell

emulation.notes: PCSX2 is the practical high-resolution capture route for an owned Japanese or European PS2 copy.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 assets and presentation with emulator-side resolution and filtering improvements.

primary.why: Michigan: Report from Hell is a PS2-only Grasshopper Manufacture horror/adventure game released in Japan and Europe, with no sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, or modern rerelease.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned Japanese or European PS2 copy on original hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for cleaner capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, PC port, North American release, or modern rerelease was identified.
